name: privacy
description: Asks before sensitive terms (people, teams, clients, internal codenames) or personal data (e-mails, phones, CPF, CNPJ, CEP, addresses, internal hosts, private IPs) leave through files, commits, pushes or published text. Only you can approve. The term lists stay outside the repository; /privacy:terms adds and suggests terms.

terms_file.title: Personal sensitive terms
terms_file.description: A text file outside any repository, one term per line, checked in every project. Empty means ~/.config/working-bee/sensitive-terms.txt, which /privacy:terms creates.

detectors.title: Detect personal data with no list
detectors.description: E-mails, phones, CPF, CNPJ, CEP, addresses, internal hosts and private IPs. A project can allow some in .claude/working-bee.json.
